name: Eurostat dissemination API (JSON-stat 2.0 and SDMX 2.1/3.0)
gives: EU, country and regional statistics: tourism nights by country of residence, population, economy, energy, with NUTS 2 and 3 regional breakdowns

why.quote: Reuse of statistical data, metadata, publications, and other dissemination tools published on this website for commercial or non-commercial purposes is authorised provided the source is acknowledged.
why.basis: copyright notice and free re-use of data (editorial content under CC BY 4.0; statistical data reuse authorised with source acknowledged); robots.txt at ec.europa.eu/eurostat: 'User-Agent: *' with empty 'Disallow:'

interface: GET https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/api/dissemination/statistics/1.0/data/{dataset}?format=JSON&lang=en&geo=...&lastTimePeriod=n returns JSON-stat 2.0. Also SDMX 2.1 (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/api/dissemination/sdmx/2.1/) and SDMX 3.0. No key.
notes: Keyless; probed on 2026-11-18. tour_occ_nin2 (nights spent, annual) answered for geo PT15 (Algarve), PT17 (Lisboa) and UKI (London) with c_resid=FOR; its title says 'by NUTS 3 region' but the codes that answered were the NUTS 2 ones, so PT150 and PT170 exactly need checking per dataset. The monthly tour_occ_nim returned no values for PT150. UK data stops after 2019 or 2020 (pre-Brexit), as Dinis expected; not checked per dataset. No rate limit found in the getting-started page; it says large requests can take minutes and an asynchronous mode exists. Attribution: 'Source: Eurostat' with dataset code. Reuse decision cited: Commission Decision of 12 December 2011. Checked in the build, 18 Nov 2026: regions have only DOM, FOR and TOTAL residence (tour_occ_nin2); named countries exist only for national data (tour_occ_ninraw annual, geo PT); tour_occ_nim has no regions (the API drops them without an error). Lisbon is PT17 to 2022, then PT1A and PT1B (NUTS 2024). London (UKI) has values only for 2012, 2015 and 2016.
how: Three requests every 6 hours (sources/eurostat-tourism/collect.mjs): tour_occ_nin2 (annual nights by region and domestic, foreign or total guest), tour_occ_ninraw (annual nights in Portugal by country of residence) and tour_occ_nim (monthly, countries only). Source: Eurostat, with the dataset code. Terms re-read 18 Nov 2026 at https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/web/main/help/copyright-notice (the copyright address in the brief now answers 404).
